# Stan Posokhov

> Front-end developer from Ukraine, building websites since 2016. Main stack: Vue 3, Nuxt 3, WordPress. Uses AI tools as an assistant in day-to-day development.

The site is a single page per language with sections: About, Skills, Certificates, Portfolio, Contacts. Sections open via URL hash, e.g. https://posokhov.com/en#portfolio.

## Pages

- [English](https://posokhov.com/en): about, skills, certificates, portfolio and contacts
- [Українська](https://posokhov.com/): the same content in Ukrainian
- [Русский](https://posokhov.com/ru): the same content in Russian
